Engineering capabilities

Depth across the stack, organized around outcomes.

The disciplines behind our services. Each engagement draws on the combination your product and environment need.

Frontend engineering

Interfaces people can use quickly and confidently, on any screen.

  • Responsive web applications
  • Component architecture and design systems
  • Accessibility-minded interfaces
  • Data-heavy dashboards and admin tools
  • Performance and Core Web Vitals
  • Mobile and cross-platform experiences

Backend engineering

Services and APIs with clear contracts and predictable behavior.

  • Service and API design
  • Domain modeling and relational data design
  • Authentication, authorization, and multi-tenancy
  • Background jobs and workflow orchestration
  • Third-party and partner integrations
  • Performance and reliability engineering

Cloud engineering

Infrastructure that is reproducible, observable, and sized to the workload.

  • Cloud architecture and environment design
  • Containerized and serverless deployment
  • Infrastructure as code
  • Networking, secrets, and access management
  • Scalability and cost management
  • Migration planning and execution

AI and machine learning

Applied AI with measurable quality, from prototype to production.

  • LLM application development
  • Retrieval-augmented generation and search
  • AI agents and tool use
  • Document understanding and extraction
  • Classification and forecasting models
  • Evaluation, guardrails, and monitoring

Data engineering

Data that is connected, trustworthy, and ready for analytics and AI.

  • Batch and streaming data pipelines
  • Data modeling and warehousing
  • Data quality checks and contracts
  • Reporting and analytics enablement
  • SaaS and enterprise system integration
  • Data preparation for AI and ML

DevOps and delivery

Releases that are routine, automated, and reversible.

  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Automated testing strategy
  • Environment and release management
  • Logs, metrics, traces, and alerting
  • Incident response runbooks
  • Developer tooling and workflows

Security engineering

Secure practices built into everyday engineering work.

Compliance and regulatory requirements are agreed per engagement, and we work within your security policies.

  • Security-focused architecture review
  • Least-privilege access and secrets management
  • Dependency and vulnerability management
  • Audit logging
  • Encryption in transit and at rest
  • Security-focused code review

How we work

A delivery process built for accountability.

Clear milestones, working software you can see, and plain-language communication at every stage. You always know what is done, what is next, and what is at risk.

Our delivery approach
  1. 01

    Discover

    Understand business needs and technical requirements.

  2. 02

    Architect

    Design a scalable, practical solution.

  3. 03

    Build

    Deliver through clear engineering milestones.

  4. 04

    Validate

    Test quality, reliability, and performance.

  5. 05

    Launch and Improve

    Deploy and support ongoing improvements.

  • Communication. Regular demos and written status updates.
  • Transparency. Shared repositories and backlogs.
  • Code quality. Review, tests, and CI on every change.
  • Accountability. Named owners for every milestone.

Why Coastline Digital

An engineering partner, not a vendor.

What working with us looks like in practice, explained rather than claimed.

Coastline Digital is based in San Diego, CA, and works with an international team of experienced engineering professionals. You know who is on your project and where they work.

About Coastline Digital

  • Experienced technical delivery

    Work is staffed with experienced engineers, and senior engineers stay involved in architecture decisions and code review throughout.

  • Direct collaboration

    You work directly with the engineers building your software, not through layers of account management.

  • Software aligned with business needs

    We start from the workflow, customer, or revenue problem and scope the technical work to solve it.

  • Practical AI implementation

    We recommend AI where it helps, test it against your real examples, and tell you when a simpler approach will work better.

  • Flexible engagement options

    Dedicated teams, defined projects, or delivery partnerships, adjusted as your needs change.

  • Long-term maintainability

    Readable code, automated tests, documentation, and decision records, so your team is never dependent on us to make a change.

  • Transparent engineering workflows

    Shared repositories, visible backlogs, regular demos, and plain-language status updates. You always know what is done, what is next, and what is at risk.
